wins: Collected a full reward budget (50) despite not completing success criteria, indicating consistent execution of initial steps before failure point.
Engaged mentor assistance promptly (10 calls) to attempt guided recovery during the single episode.
Maintained a stable reward trend with no decline, showing controlled actions even under failure.
fails: Episode ended without achieving success criteria, pointing to a critical control or containment failure after reconnaissance.
Zero success rate implies inability to progress past lateral movement or persistence phase despite initial reconnaissance.
High reliance on mentor calls suggests gaps in autonomous decision-making or execution of follow-up actions.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance actions were executed consistently (full reward per episode), but the run failed to transition to exploitation/persistence phases; focus on automating follow-on actions and reducing dependence on mentor intervention.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to establish persistence after initial access, causing premature episode termination.
